classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish retained sector angles from removed wedges, scale both end areas and curved area by the retained fraction, and add two unscaled cut rectangles. The arc-length hint supplies the curved-surface route.

inlines.text: Find the surface area of these closed partial cylinders. Answer in exact form.

spec.description: Upright closed cylinder with a 90-degree sector removed; radius label on an upper cut radius, height on the left silhouette, and a projected right-angle cue at the upper centre.
spec.mathematics: Radius 4 m, height 6 m, retained sector 270 degrees; two sector ends, retained curved surface and two radial rectangles.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; supplied answer excluded from the question figure.

answer.worked:
The remaining angle is $360^\circ-90^\circ=270^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Two ends}&=2\times\frac{270}{360}\times\pi(4)^2=24\pi\ \mathrm{m}^2\\\text{Curved surface}&=\frac{270}{360}\times2\pi(4)(6)=36\pi\ \mathrm{m}^2\\\text{Cut rectangles}&=2(4)(6)=48\ \mathrm{m}^2\\\text{Surface area}&=24\pi+36\pi+48\\&=(60\pi+48)\ \mathrm{m}^2\end{aligned}$$
